voices.name: l00
voices.text: When things go well, <#0.2#> anyone can be a good person.
voices.caption: When things go well, anyone can be a good person.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: But at the bottom, <#0.3#> the truth shows.
voices.caption: But at the bottom, the truth shows.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Some blame others, <#0.2#> and try to hurt them.
voices.caption: Some blame others, and try to hurt them.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Some learn, <#0.2#> grow, and create something.
voices.caption: Some learn, grow, and create something.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Feeling low isn't wrong. <#0.2#> What matters is what you do with that time.
voices.caption: Feeling low isn't wrong. What matters is what you do with that time.
